doc.title: Slide Hampton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Family roots in Richmond, Virginia, and the Hampton name
summary: Questions about where the family came from: Richmond, Virginia, and an English surname from a slave owner.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: No, no. We moved from Pennsylvania when I was three years old.
At the point where the family started, did your family come to Pennsylvania and start a unit? Or was there a family network around Jeannette?
Before. We started the musical unit before Jeannette.
Yeah. The band was in existence before I was born.
So your family had come to Jeannette.
Do you know where the Hampton name comes from?
Not exactly. It’s an English name. So it’s from some slave owner.
But you don’t track it back to beyond, “we came from Virginia”? We can’t go back any further than that.
I pretty much know what I’m going to find. So I don’t know whether that would be a good idea or not.
